title: Ideal Goggles
summary: Privacy-first AI desktop photo manager — all inference runs locally; zero cloud uploads.
description: Electron → React 19 → FastAPI → CLIP, InsightFace, and Tesseract → SQLite. Natural language search, face recognition, OCR, and duplicate detection across 100,000+ photos with sub-2s search. Cross-platform macOS, Windows, and Linux. 91+ PRs merged; CI/CD via GitHub Actions with Codecov.

title: Invoicing & Communications Platform
summary: Architecture-led work on merchant invoicing — whitelabeling, aggregation, reliability, and API governance.
description: Email & URL whitelabeling from discovery to production; invoice aggregation with phased rollout and zero P1s; observability and daily health digests; progressive API gating with fraud signals; webhooks with at-least-once delivery; Redis-backed read path improvements and test modernization.

title: RFID / IoT Asset Platform
summary: Industrial IoT tracking with Impinj RFID, real-time maps, and extensible hardware plugins.
description: Hardware adapter architecture (OctaneSDK, Chronicle Queue, Drools), spatial tracking with WebSocket and Konva maps, plugin model for new hardware, and check-in/check-out with OTA updates for edge devices.

title: ERP Performance & Architecture
summary: Query optimization and integration patterns across a 20-module wholesale ERP.
description: Batching and connection management for cross-module data access; configurable service locator for API routing; C4 diagrams for stakeholder alignment.

title: Port Advancer
summary: Internal developer tool for port-forwarding and reverse proxying on a restricted corporate network.
description: Node.js CLI used by 60+ engineers for secure port-forward and reverse-proxy workflows behind corporate restrictions.

title: Skill Seekers
summary: Automatically convert any documentation website into a Claude AI skill.
description: Contribution to an automated tool that transforms documentation websites into production-ready Claude skills. Features universal scraping, PDF support, MCP integration, and AI-powered enhancement.

title: Utils Commons
summary: Java utility library inspired by Apache Commons IO.
description: General-purpose utilities for String, Number, Date, Set, List, BLOB, and Zip operations.

title: Vue Embed Gist
summary: Open-source contribution to a Vue component for embedding GitHub Gists.
description: Merged contribution to sudhanshu-15/vue-embed-gist — package averages 270+ weekly npm downloads.

title: Mydia
summary: Self-hosted media management platform with unified movies & TV tracking.
description: Modern media companion built with Phoenix LiveView. Features automated downloads, multi-user system with SSO, real-time calendar, and native indexer support. Combines the best of Radarr/Sonarr in one unified app.
